candidate: Fixed-state, all-consumer-path causal intervention on one runtime-selected memory item, localized to a pre-treatment geometry support against a mask-area baseline, with the item-level causal score predicting natural revisit failure or benefit.

evidence_policy.negative_search_rule: NO_IN_CHECKED_SOURCE means no matching method was identified in the explicitly audited accessible sources. It does not mean the method does not exist.
evidence_policy.unpublished_rule: An author-homepage In Progress entry without a public paper or code is an UNPUBLISHED_SIGNAL and is NOT_ASSESSABLE on all contract criteria.
evidence_policy.novelty_rule: Absence from the checked set does not authorize first, novel, no-prior-work, or CCF-A-level claims.

status_vocabulary.FULL: The checked primary method explicitly satisfies the complete criterion.
status_vocabulary.PARTIAL: The work contains an adjacent capability but misses at least one required constraint.
status_vocabulary.ANALOGUE_ONLY: A strict analogue exists in another task, but it does not directly satisfy the world-model memory contract.
status_vocabulary.NO_IN_CHECKED_SOURCE: No satisfying method was identified in the checked primary-source scope; not an existence claim.
status_vocabulary.NOT_ASSESSABLE: No public method and experiment are available for assessment.

contract_criteria.name: runtime_selected_single_item_intervention
contract_criteria.definition: Intervene on one memory item that was actually selected in an ordinary runtime execution, rather than disabling a whole module, all context, or an arbitrary hidden component.

contract_criteria.name: all_relevant_state_fixed
contract_criteria.definition: Hold prompt, pose, intrinsics, selected IDs and order, non-target memory, latents or actual sampling noise, RNG, sampler, and other relevant state fixed, with exact replay establishing the null distribution.

contract_criteria.name: source_coherent_all_consumer_paths
contract_criteria.definition: Apply the same source change coherently through every real consumer path; single-path CLIP, latent, KV, or attention-edge interventions are diagnostic only.

contract_criteria.name: pretreatment_geometry_localization_and_area_baseline
contract_criteria.definition: Localize output causal change to a source geometry support frozen before intervention and show concentration beyond a mask-area or equivalent chance baseline.

contract_criteria.name: predicts_natural_revisit_failure_or_benefit
contract_criteria.definition: Show that the item-level causal score predicts unmanipulated natural revisit failure or benefit with paired, incremental, or calibrated evidence.

target_papers.title: Vision-Language Binding in In-Context Image Generation

official_code_snapshot.commit_subject: Add new experiments and evaluation tooling

primary_capabilities: T2I Lens decodes intermediate text-token activations through a T2I path.
Attention Knockout severs selected reference-to-text or reference-to-image attention edges.
I2I-to-I2I patching transfers text-token activations from a source reference run to a target reference run.
The paper reports 2875 image-editing tasks and uses different source and target noise seeds.
Official code reconstructs target baseline and patched target with the same target seed, prompt, reference, and dimensions.
Reference-text binding is localized to text-sequence padding tokens.
The paper explicitly notes incomplete patching and possible secondary or backup paths.

post_paper_official_code_signal.name: repair_amplify
post_paper_official_code_signal.interpretation: The later repository triages failed style transfers and amplifies selected causal paths, connecting mechanism analysis to attempted repair.
post_paper_official_code_signal.claim_boundary: No unified repair rate is computed because task pools and grading conditions differ across files. This remains I2I path amplification, not natural world-model revisit prediction.

C1.reason: The intervention target is a reference image or text-token activation in image editing, not one runtime-selected historical world-memory item.

C2.reason: The target run fixes target seed, prompt, reference, and dimensions, which is a strong causal analogue, but it is not a full world-model replay with retrieval set, poses, caches, and all other memory consumers fixed.

C3.reason: Text-token patching leaves the target reference path active; knockout targets selected edges. The paper itself indicates backup or secondary paths.

C4.reason: Padding-token localization is sequence localization, not output localization to a pre-treatment 3D geometry support with area baseline.

C5.reason: The main study and later repair-amplify files do not establish preregistered prediction of natural video-world-model revisit failure or benefit.

target_papers.title: MosaicMem: Hybrid Spatial Memory for Controllable Video World Models
target_papers.code_publication_status: The official project page displayed Code (Coming) at the evidence freeze. No official V1 repository link was retrieved.
primary_capabilities: Localized patches are lifted into 3D using depth, intrinsics, and pose and reprojected into the target view.
Warped RoPE and Warped Latent align retrieved memory with target latents.
The system supports sparse and dense retrieval, deletion, duplication, relocation, scene stitching, minute-scale navigation, and autoregressive rollouts.
Consistency Score uses SSIM, PSNR, and LPIPS inside annotated corresponding regions.
Reported failure modes include insufficient retrieval under large camera motion and boundary object artifacts under Warped RoPE.

C1.reason: Patch-level retrieval and manipulation exist, but no matched causal intervention on one patch actually selected during an ordinary run is reported.

C2.reason: No item-level exact replay freezes retrieval IDs, all other memory, noise or RNG, pose, and all relevant state.

C3.reason: The checked paper does not establish a coherent same-source intervention through every memory consumer path.

C4.reason: Pre-existing patch geometry and region-restricted consistency metrics exist, but there is no causal output-difference concentration test against support area.

C5.reason: Natural revisit benefits and system-level failures are reported, but no per-item causal score predicts which natural revisit fails or benefits.

target_papers.title: Compression and Retrieval: Implicit Memory Retrieval for Video World Models

official_code_snapshot.release_boundary: Inference is public. The frozen README still lists training and parts of the checkpoint or full SceneFly release as future work.

primary_capabilities: Compressed whole-history context is queried through attention with relative camera pose.
The A-B-C-B-D-B-A trajectory visualizes stronger attention for view-close context clips.
Revisit performance is evaluated with PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and FVD.

C1.reason: Retrieval is a continuous attention distribution over compressed context, and no one selected item is causally intervened on.

C2.reason: No item-level fixed-state exact replay protocol is reported.

C3.reason: No coherent all-consumer-path source intervention is reported.

C4.reason: Attention visualizations and camera relations are not a pre-treatment output-effect mask test with an area baseline.

C5.reason: The paper evaluates natural or constructed revisits, but does not predict them using a per-item causal score.

target_papers.title: DreamX-World 1.0: A General-Purpose Interactive World Model
primary_capabilities: Camera-geometry overlap retrieves non-local memory frames.
Memory, recent context, and target latents share the conditioning stream.
Residual Recycling perturbs conditioning tokens while leaving the target clean to improve robustness to imperfect memory latents.
Revisit evaluation covers pixel, perceptual, semantic, place-recognition, and geometric consistency.
Non-revisit pairs with a matched temporal-gap distribution provide a behavioral baseline.

C1.reason: Runtime geometry selection exists, but no causal intervention on one selected memory frame is reported.

C2.reason: No per-item exact replay freezing all relevant state is reported.

C3.reason: No source-coherent intervention across every consumer path is reported.

C4.reason: Geometry drives retrieval and evaluation includes geometric similarity, but no causal output effect is localized to a frozen source support against area.

C5.reason: Natural revisit and imperfect-memory behavior are directly evaluated, but not predicted by a per-item causal score.

pressure_neighbors.title: Matrix-Game 3.5: Enhancing Real-Time Streaming Interactive World Models with Patch Memory
capabilities: Explicit 3D patch memory with per-patch geometric reprojection.
Z-buffer selection of a visible surface for each target cell.
Aligned memory canvas with reverse mapping to source frame and original patch location.
Patch memory, context, anchor, target, and dynamic-subject reference tokens in one pose-aware self-attention sequence.
Fixed initial state, camera trajectory, prompt, and random seed for a whole reference-prefix ablation.

C1.reason: Selected patch provenance exists, but the causal ablation removes an entire dynamic-subject reference prefix rather than one selected patch or source.

C2.reason: The reference-prefix ablation explicitly fixes initial state, camera trajectory, prompt, and seed, but it is not an item-level exact replay over the full memory state.

C3.reason: Multiple patch, context, and reference paths can carry related evidence; no one-source all-path intervention is established.

C4.reason: The aligned canvas and reverse map provide pre-treatment support and provenance, but no causal effect-concentration versus area test is reported.

C5.reason: Long-horizon recall and ablation effects are shown, but no per-item causal score predicts natural revisit failure or benefit.

pressure_neighbors.pressure_conclusion: Patch provenance, geometry support, unified attention, and fixed-seed module ablation cannot be claimed as separate novelties. Only the joint source-total-effect, geometry-localized, natural-error-predictive contract remains differentiating in the checked scope.

pressure_neighbors.title: R2M-Bench: Evaluating Revisit Memory via Relative Consistency in Interactive Video World Models
capabilities: Same-rollout gap-matched baseline and short-range controls.
MemoryGain, dynamic range, and Normalized Memory Ratio.
Five families covering appearance, scene identity, object identity, local geometry, and persistent state.
pressure_neighbors.explicit_claim_boundary: The paper states that positive MemoryGain should not be interpreted as a causal estimate of an internal memory mechanism and that system differences confound retrieval conclusions.

C2.reason: Same-rollout controls are not an item-level internal intervention replay.

C4.reason: Local-geometry metrics are observable evaluation, not causal source-support localization.

C5.reason: It supplies strong natural revisit outcomes and baselines, but not a per-item causal predictor.

pressure_neighbors.title: ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
capabilities: Bounded KV landmark consolidation and pose retrieval.
Palindrome revisit protocol with matched prompts, fixed seed, and common camera intent.
SSIM, LPIPS, DINO, and ORB revisit metrics.

C1.reason: No one selected landmark or chunk is causally intervened on.

C2.reason: The evaluation fixes seed and intent, but no full item-level exact replay is reported.

C4.reason: No pre-treatment geometry effect mask and area baseline.

C5.reason: Strong natural revisit protocol, but no per-source causal score prediction.

pressure_neighbors.title: Do Video Generators Track the World Across Segments? A Benchmark and Method for World-State Reasoning in Video Continuation
capabilities: Separates observation memory from physical world-state reasoning.
Uses hidden or ambiguous boundary state and future actions that reveal the required state.
Covers visibility, location, containment, transformation, surface or material state, quantity, and agent-object relations.

C1.reason: No single internal memory-item causal intervention.

C5.reason: It provides natural state-failure labels but does not predict them from an item-level causal memory score.

pressure_neighbors.design_implication: Future natural-error labels must separate failure to consume valid memory from consumption of stale memory and failure of state-update reasoning.

unpublished_signals.title: MosaicMem V2: Object-Centric Controllability on a Memory Canvas for AI Game Worlds
unpublished_signals.homepage_abstract_signal: Object-centric controllable generation on a persistent memory canvas, targeting interactive AI game world creation.
unpublished_signals.search_boundary: Exact-title searches of arXiv and GitHub did not retrieve an official public paper or code at the evidence freeze. This does not assert that no private or later artifact exists.
unpublished_signals.kill_trigger: Immediately re-audit if a public version reports a single-object or single-patch source-coherent replay, geometry effect concentration with a mask-area baseline, natural revisit prediction, or especially all of these with fixed state and all consumer paths.

joint_contract_summary.interpretation: No public primary source in the explicitly audited set was identified as satisfying all five conditions.

verdict.reason: The expanded backward, forward, and author-recent primary-source audit did not identify a public method satisfying the full five-condition contract. Matrix-Game 3.5 sharply narrows the gap, and unpublished MosaicMem V2 is a high-priority unassessable risk.
verdict.allowed_claim: The five-condition joint contract was not identified in the stated accessible primary-source scope.
forbidden_claims: the field has no equivalent method
next_decisive_requirements: One memory source selected by an ordinary runtime run.
F00, F10, F01, and F11 with F11 minus F00 as the main total-effect contrast.
Pre-intervention geometry support and support-area baseline.
Within-support, outside-support, total-effect, and paired uncertainty estimates.
Incremental prediction of natural revisit error or benefit from the item causal score.
R2M MemoryGain, dynamic range, and NMR as behavioral baselines.
A stale-but-geometrically-valid memory control to separate memory consumption from state-update reasoning.
Matrix-Game 3.5 patch provenance and fixed-seed module ablation as strong baselines.
reassessment_triggers: A later public primary source satisfies all five criteria.
MosaicMem V2 becomes public and exposes the relevant item-level protocol.
Exact replay variance is comparable to the candidate effect.
The geometry-localization confidence bound does not exceed area baseline.
The item causal score does not predict natural revisit error or benefit.

limitations: Forward-citation indexes are incomplete, inconsistent, and rapidly changing; their returned lists are not exhaustive.
Vision-Language Binding forward enumeration was not reliable because of an HTTP 429 and an empty endpoint response that cannot support a zero claim.
MosaicMem V1 official code was still marked Coming on its project page, limiting code-level inspection.
CaR public release completeness is limited by repository TODO items.
Title and abstract screening is shallower than full-method review for lower-pressure forward candidates.
MosaicMem V2 has no public paper or code and cannot be scientifically assessed.
No experimental novelty or performance claim is authorized by this literature audit.
